summary: This 8-K report is filed by BA Credit Card Funding, LLC, as depositor, on behalf of BA Credit Card Trust and BA Master Credit Card Trust II, announcing a planned issuance of BAseries Class A(2026-1) Notes by the BA Credit Card Trust on May 14, 2026. The filing reports an event under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and includes an exhibit. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is present. This is a routine capital markets transaction for an asset-backed securities issuer, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions. The filing is procedural and discloses no fundamental corporate change.
